skills.name: 明任
skills.officialText: 游戏开始时，你摸两张牌，然后将你的一张手牌扣置于你的武将牌上，称为“任”。结束阶段，你可以用手牌替换“任”。

skills.name: 贞良
skills.officialText: 转换技，阳：出牌阶段限一次，你可以选择一名攻击范围内的其他角色并弃置x张与“任”颜色相同的牌对其造成1点伤害（x为你与其体力值之差且至少为1） 阴：你的回合外，当一名角色使用或打出的牌结算结束后，若此牌与“任”类型相同，则你可令一名角色摸两张牌。

engineeringDecisions.decision: One real Hand entity is face-down in a source-named persistent private pile; the owner sees the exact entity and other viewers only its count. Mingren and Zhenliang from the same actual skill-grant source share that Ren. Ending exchanges one current Hand entity and the old Ren through genuine movement; no draw, discard or recast is invented.

X=max(1,abs(owner HP-target HP)), requiring genuine defined HP on both sides. At target acceptance freeze X and Ren effective color; pay exactly X currently owned legal Hand/Equipment entities in one native logical discard. Finish removal/recovery/gain children before native damage1. Paid damage survives loss of the originating skill. Actual-Play quota is shared by owner and named skill across regrant instances.

Compare standard Basic/Trick/Equipment category of the completed effective card action with Ren type. Any character may be actor/provider, including pure Played responses and zero-entity Uses. One native action is counted once. Outside-turn scope lasts until the actual turn cursor returns, including children after raw TurnEnded. Once recipient is selected, toggle native conversion polarity and finish a genuine native Draw2, including native draw replacement and short stock.

A Ren belongs to its concrete Mingren skill grant; actual grant removal or owner death removes the remaining entity through native movement. Already paid effects retain frozen ownership and payment receipts.
